members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport.close() doesn't settle pending JSON-response-mode POST requests (or their promises), leaving the HTTP request hanging until the platform's own timeout instead of resolving immediately when the transport closes. (2 PRs)
members.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport.close() doesn't settle pending JSON-response-mode POST requests (or their promises), leaving the HTTP request hanging until the platform's own timeout instead of resolving immediately when the transport closes. (2 PRs)
members.cluster_pick_reason: 2600's diff covers a superset of the fix: besides settling parked JSON-response-mode POSTs on close(), it also clears the previously-uncleared _requestToStreamMapping correlations and re-checks them after the storeEvent() await, closing a leak/race that lets a suspended send() resolve against a retired correlation after close(). It also documents that both fixes apply through to NodeStreamableHTTPServerTransport, which wraps this transport. 2692 only addresses the promise-settling half of the same close() path (with batched-request grouping and a JSON-RPC -32000 code) but doesn't mention the correlation-leak/race fix, so consolidating onto 2600 keeps the more complete change; the batched-request grouping nuance from 2692 should be carried over during merge review.
